meetings.title: Architecture & Database Selection Review
meetings.transcript:
Elena: Welcome everyone. We need to finalize the data persistence layer for Project V2. Sarah, what are the architecture findings?
Sarah: We evaluated MongoDB, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. PostgreSQL is our recommended choice because Project V2 demands strict ACID transaction compliance for our multi-tenant billing engine, plus the core engineering team already has 5+ years of deep operational expertise with it.
Arun: I agree. PostgreSQL jsonb indexing gives us the document-model flexibility without sacrificing relational integrity.
Marcus: Migration and schema sharding at scale will be complex, but we can manage that with Timescale/Citus if required.
Elena: Perfect. Decision approved: We will use PostgreSQL for Project V2. Sarah, please draft the schema specification by July 25. Arun, start the local database containerization.
meetings.summary: Finalized PostgreSQL as the primary database for Project V2 based on ACID transaction needs and team expertise over MongoDB and MySQL.

decisions.title: Adopt PostgreSQL as Primary Database for Project V2
decisions.rationale: Strict ACID transaction requirements for multi-tenant billing + existing engineering team expertise and JSONB support.
consequences: High write-throughput sharding will need Citus/Timescale in Phase 3

tasks.title: Setup PostgreSQL Dockerized Local & Staging Clusters

risks.title: Database Migration & Sharding Complexity
risks.impactChain: Data Growth -> Sharding Overhead -> Latency Spikes
risks.mitigation: Setup connection pooling (PgBouncer) and evaluate Citus extension early.

meetings.title: V2 Sprint Planning & Launch Milestones
meetings.transcript:
Elena: Let's establish our official release target for Project V2. We are aiming for Friday, August 28th for general availability.
Arun: For the backend, I will finish the core API Integration endpoints by Wednesday, August 26th.
Dev: The testing and QA team requires at least two full business days after API completion to execute regression tests and load benchmarks before greenlighting production.
Elena: Understood. Arun commits to Wednesday Aug 26, Dev gets Thursday & Friday for QA, and we launch Friday August 28th at 5 PM. Let's make this our locked milestone.
meetings.summary: Set target production launch date for Project V2 on Friday, August 28th. Arun to complete API integration by Wednesday Aug 26; Dev (QA) allocated 2 days for verification.

decisions.title: Project V2 Launch Milestone Scheduled for August 28
decisions.rationale: Aligns with customer renewals cycle and executive Q3 board demonstration.
consequences: Zero buffer between QA signoff and production deployment
Any API slip blocks the Friday release

risks.title: Tight Cascade Dependency Risk (API -> QA -> Launch)
risks.impactChain: Arun API Delay -> QA Bottleneck -> Production Launch Slip
risks.mitigation: Mock API contracts for QA so test cases can be automated in parallel.

meetings.title: Mid-Sprint Sync & Status Check
meetings.transcript:
Elena: Let's do a quick sync. Arun, how is API integration progressing? In the marketing briefing, someone mentioned we are launching on August 21?
Arun: That was a misunderstanding from marketing; our target is next week. Also, we encountered third-party webhook rate limits which might push API completion from Wednesday to Thursday.
Dev: If the API is handed over on Thursday instead of Wednesday, QA cannot complete full security regression by Friday morning!
Marcus: Also we need the staging SSL certificates renewed before testing can connect to auth servers.
meetings.summary: Detected timeline confusion regarding launch dates. Arun flagged potential 1-day delay on API integration due to webhook rate limits, triggering a critical QA blocker warning.

decisions.title: Reject Expedited Aug 21 Launch (Enforce Aug 28 Target)
alternatives: Rushed release on Aug 21 without QA
decisions.rationale: Releasing without full security audit introduces catastrophic data leakage risk.
consequences: Marketing team must retract external newsletter

risks.title: API Handover Slip Causing QA Starvation
risks.impactChain: Webhook Throttling -> Thursday API Drop -> 24h QA Deficit -> Launch Weekend Failure
risks.mitigation: Assign Sarah to assist Arun on rate limit queue so API finishes on Wednesday.

meetings.title: Emergency Readiness & Mitigation Alignment
meetings.transcript:
Elena: We called this emergency alignment to resolve the critical path blocker. Sarah has paired with Arun to resolve the webhook queue.
Sarah: The Redis rate-limit queue is built and tested. Arun is now back on track to deliver the finalized API endpoints by Wednesday 2 PM.
Dev: Excellent. If we get the build by Wednesday 2 PM, QA will run smoke tests overnight and complete full regression by Friday 12 PM.
Marcus: Automated blue-green deployment pipelines are pre-warmed. We are go for launch on Friday August 28 at 5:00 PM UTC.
Elena: Perfect. Follow-up actions: Automate status notification to executive stakeholders upon Wednesday QA handover.
meetings.summary: Risk mitigated. Sarah and Arun paired to unblock rate-limiting. Wednesday 2 PM delivery reaffirmed, allowing QA to finish testing on schedule for Friday launch.

decisions.title: Pair Sarah with Arun for Critical Path Unblocking
decisions.chosenOption: Pair Architecture Lead directly on API Queue
decisions.rationale: Preserves the August 28 deadline while maintaining full feature completeness and QA duration.
consequences: Sarah's Phase 3 design work paused for 2 days

tasks.title: Execute Wednesday 2 PM Build Delivery to QA
Send Executive Status Check at Wednesday Handover

risks.title: Residual Flakiness in Third-Party Webhook Provider
risks.impactChain: Provider Downtime -> Retry Backoff -> Minor User Webhook Delay
risks.mitigation: Dead letter queue and automatic circuit breaker configured.

contradictions.title: Launch Target Discrepancy (Aug 28 vs Aug 21)
contradictions.statementA: Meeting 2 (Aug 10): 'Target general availability is Friday, August 28th.'
contradictions.statementB: Meeting 3 (Aug 20): 'Marketing briefing mentioned launching on August 21.'
contradictions.resolution: Marketing rumor was retracted in Meeting 3; August 28 confirmed as official release.

contradictions.statementA: Meeting 2 (Aug 10): 'Arun commits to Wednesday Aug 26; Dev needs 2 full days before Friday launch.'
contradictions.statementB: Meeting 3 (Aug 20): 'Arun flags rate limit delays pushing API delivery to Thursday.'
